applicabilityBasis.summary: USD0 is marketed as a dollar payment/settlement stablecoin, but its primary redemption route exchanges the token for tokenized Treasury collateral and its indirect USDC route depends on counterparties and liquidity. GENIUS section 2(22) requires an issuer obligation to convert, redeem or repurchase for fixed monetary value, not merely a fixed-denomination digital asset. Usual terms disclaim ADDU participation in protocol transactions and do not establish an enforceable USD-redemption obligation. The public evidence leaves that obligation unresolved. DAO organization and France-based service providers alone are not a statutory exclusion.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. The USD0 factsheet identifies Usual DAO as issuer and describes DAO protocol ownership under UIP-15, with Usual Labs as a service provider. ADDU is the French interface co-contracting association and Up Only Co is the developer. These identities do not establish the DAO legal domicile, so the former France issuerDomicile assertion is omitted. Direct redemption delivers tokenized Treasury collateral; the indirect USDC route depends on counterparties and liquidity. The opened terms do not resolve a legally enforceable national-currency redemption obligation. U.S. persons are excluded from interface use, which does not establish a GENIUS foreign exception or blanket secondary ownership prohibition. Official collateral and redemption disclosures are public; no monthly token-level reserve attestation was located, and the issuer describes on-chain transparency instead of periodic token attestations. No named public authorization, officially pending application, foreign registration or enforcement action was located in the consulted sources. The Act remains pre-effective; the September 30 state-certification procedural rule does not activate the issuer and distribution framework.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no source in this consulted set names Usual DAO or USD0 as a permitted payment stablecoin issuer, state-qualified issuer, officially pending GENIUS applicant or registered foreign issuer. No named public enforcement action was located in the scoped official-domain searches. General regulator proposals, regulated reserve assets, and Monerium fiat-rail licensing do not establish token authorization. These are negative findings limited to the opened materials and searches, not a certification of universal absence.
